chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Hashimi, from Abu Ja'far al-Attar — a shaykh from the people of Medina. He said: I heard al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) say:

A man came to the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) and said: O Messenger of God! My sins have become numerous and my good deeds have weakened. The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Increase your prostrations, for indeed it brings down sins just as the wind brings down the leaves of a tree.

key_terms.الذُّنُوب: sins — plural of dhanb, moral transgressions requiring repentance
key_terms.السُّجُود: prostration(s) — the act of placing the forehead on the ground in prayer; the most intimate position of worship
key_terms.الْعَمَل: deeds/actions — righteous acts performed for God's sake

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about increasing prostration to erase sins?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reports a hadith from the Prophet in which a man confesses to being overwhelmed by sins and a weakening of his good deeds. The Prophet's remedy is beautifully simple: increase prostration (sujud). The simile — that prostration strips away sins like wind strips leaves from a tree — would have resonated powerfully with the original audience, evoking the image of a tree suddenly bare and clean after a strong gust.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Safar narrated to us from al-`Abbas b. Ma`ruf from `Ali b. Mahziyar from Ja`far b. Muhammad al-Hashimi from Abi Ja`far al-`Attar – a shaykh from the people of Medina. He said: I heard al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) say:

A man came to the Messenger of Allah (s) and said: O Messenger of Allah! My sins have become numerous, and my good work has weakened. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: Increase in prostrating, for it brings down sins just as a breeze brings down the leaves of a tree.
